expectations.text: Recent-discourse research was performed (checking /mnt/skills/plugins/last30days/SKILL.md and using fallback search when unavailable) and used only to sharpen Hook and angle
Zero unapproved research facts, statistics, study names, or external quotes were added to the script, and no research notes appear in the output
All five beats (Hook, Story, Turn, Takeaway, Closer) are present in exact order with 45s timing labels (0-3s, 3-20s, 20-32s, 32-42s, 42-45s)
Spoken word count (excluding beat labels) is within 100-120 words
Hook is one striking opening sentence with no greeting or setup
Takeaway includes exactly one practical action (write the core logic yourself before using AI to clean it up)
No visual/style/motion direction, no invented story details beyond the user's prompt, and reads naturally aloud with zero AI tells
expectations.evidence: Hook introduced unprompted rhetorical durations ('in ten minutes', 'all afternoon') and Story added 'opened the file together'
